notes: No missing works can be added with confidence. The database and queue already hold Schütt's main violin works: the Sonata Op. 26, Suites Op. 44 and Op. 61, the Op. 52 and Op. 53 pieces, the 'À la bien-aimée' arrangement, and the single pieces. Other possible items (further violin arrangements from the piano miniatures, such as Op. 59 or Op. 16, and a possible romance) could not be confirmed with a named edition or a certain catalogue number, so they were left out.
